about.title: About Xorazm Tour
about.subtitle: Your gateway to the wonders of ancient Khorezm
about.mission_text: We are dedicated to unveiling the rich historical heritage of the Khorezm region to travelers from around the world. Our team of local experts crafts immersive experiences that connect you with centuries-old traditions, stunning architecture, and the warm hospitality of Uzbekistan.
about.why_local_text: Born and raised in Khorezm, our guides offer authentic insights into the region's history, culture, and hidden gems that only locals know.
about.why_curated_text: Every tour is meticulously planned to balance historical exploration, cultural immersion, and comfortable travel.
about.why_heritage_text: We are committed to sustainable tourism that supports local communities and preserves the region's UNESCO World Heritage sites.
about.mission_point_1: Authentic local expertise and heritage knowledge
about.why_subtitle: Discover what sets Xorazm Tour apart as your dedicated local partner along the Silk Road
about.cta_subtitle: Begin your journey through the wonders of ancient Khorezm with our expert guides and curated experiences.

legal.privacy_intro: Xorazm Tour and Travels respects your privacy and processes personal information strictly to coordinate your travel inquiries and reservations.
legal.privacy_collect_body: When you submit a tour booking request, contact form message, or newsletter subscription, we collect the details you provide such as your name, email address, phone number, preferred travel dates, traveler counts, and special requests.
legal.privacy_use_body: Your details are used solely to respond to travel inquiries, prepare personalized itineraries, confirm accommodation and transport arrangements, and send requested updates. We never sell or rent traveler contact details to third parties.
legal.privacy_sharing_body: Only essential reservation details are shared with vetted hospitality, guide, or transport partners directly fulfilling your booked itinerary in Uzbekistan.
legal.privacy_rights_body: You may request a copy, correction, or deletion of your contact or booking records at any time by writing to xorazmtour@gmail.com.
legal.terms_intro: These guidelines outline how tour requests, pricing estimates, schedule adjustments, and cancellations are handled by Xorazm Tour and Travels.
legal.terms_booking_body: Submitting the online booking modal creates a formal reservation request with a unique reference code. A booking becomes confirmed once our Khiva coordinator verifies availability and issues written confirmation.
legal.terms_pricing_body: Displayed per-person estimates depend on total adult participants, selected accommodation category, and seasonal transport tariffs. Final confirmed totals and payment options are detailed in your written itinerary offer.
legal.terms_cancellation_body: Date or group-size changes requested in advance are accommodated wherever possible at no administrative fee. External hotel, rail, or domestic flight supplier terms apply to late cancellations.
legal.terms_responsibility_body: Travelers are responsible for holding a valid passport, any applicable Uzbekistan entry visa or e-visa, and comprehensive personal travel and medical insurance.
legal.questions_body: Contact our Khiva team directly at xorazmtour@gmail.com or +998 94 315 75 79.
